# Maaack/Godot-Game-Template notice

This project incorporates and adapts portions of Maaack/Godot-Game-Template v1.4.7, commit `93e66a02b979872b870ccb5ac1452f8d6a31c737`.

Adapted concepts and code are limited to:

- asynchronous scene loading and a project-owned loading screen;
- cross-scene music ownership;
- automatic discovery of UI controls for sound feedback;
- pause request handling;
- the main-menu/settings/pause interaction foundation.

The upstream examples, GlobalState, PlayerConfig, input remapping, logos and demonstration assets are not included. See `LICENSE.txt` in this directory for the MIT license.
